title: Computed keys that are equal fail the literal at run time
purpose: Equal computed keys fail the literal after every entry was evaluated once, left to right.

stdout.text:
before
key a
value 1
key b
value 2
key a
value 3

provenance.expected_basis: #954: keys the compiler cannot compute are checked when the literal is built, by the map's own key equality; every key and value is evaluated once, left to right, before the map is built, and the literal then fails.
